basics.name: Thien Nguyen
basics.label: Lead Software Engineer & Agentic AI Architect
basics.summary: Lead Software Engineer & Architect with 10+ years designing resilient distributed systems, enterprise platforms, and developer tooling. Currently leads application architecture and engineering-effectiveness frameworks at CHECK24, where systems close 30,000+ contracts daily, scaling task-execution velocity 3-10x by engineering multi-agent orchestration layers (Cursor, Codex, automated feedback loops) across the SDLC. A hands-on technical lead and mentor with a founder's track record (Guardz, Wishees, Kim Tuoc Software), pairing a gifted mathematics background with strict engineering discipline: type-safe boundaries, SOLID design, and contract-first APIs.

work.name: CHECK24 Vergleichsportal GmbH
highlights: AI-Native SDLC Architecture: designed and deployed a multi-agent orchestration control plane (Cursor, Codex, model pipelines) that automates code review, behavioral audits, and PR triage - a 3-10x task-velocity lift across engineering teams.
Architectural Stewardship: scaled enterprise frontend systems via micro-frontends and Feature-Sliced Design (FSD), holding near-zero bug density and production integrity for millions of weekly users.

Context Retrieval Infrastructure: built a localized lexical RAG system with token-bounded context windows for internal architecture docs, cutting inference token costs while maximizing retrieval accuracy.

Engineering Mentorship & Governance: anchored engineering craft through global code reviews, advanced TypeScript adoption, and formal ADRs; mentored developers on distributed system design through organizational restructuring.

Cross-Functional Knowledge Automation: built translation workflows that turn complex architectural state into structured insight for product management, accelerating alignment and surfacing technical debt earlier.

work.name: CHECK24 Vergleichsportal GmbH
highlights: State & Stream Management: established a reactive architecture (Zustand + RxJS) powering high-frequency UI updates for complex pricing engines at peak performance.

Quality Gates & Performance: enforced rigorous Vitest test coverage and fixed rendering/store-access bottlenecks, eliminating regressions across long-living production modules.
Core Product Delivery: shipped the Real-Time Pricing Calculator and Dynamic Tariff Comparison system, handling high-traffic flows and intricate business logic.
